title: RNA Extraction from Cecum Contents of Gnotobiotic Mice
author: Haley Gause
materials: Follow NEB Monarch RNA Clean-up as documented in product's protocol and detailed below:
Follow NEB Monarch RNA Clean-up as documented in product's protocol and detailed below:

steps.title: Harvest and Stabilize Cecum Contents
steps.instruction: Harvest the cecum and cecum contents, then stabilize the sample.

substeps.instruction: Drop 1/2 of cecum contents into 10 ml RNAlater.
Leave tubes at 4°C for a minimum of 1 day and a maximum of 7 days.

steps.title: Aliquot and Pellet Cecum Contents
steps.instruction: Prepare weighed aliquots of the stabilized cecum contents.

substeps.instruction: Pre-weigh 2ml tubes.
Add 1ml of RNAlater-cecum contents (~200mg contents) to each tube using wide-bore 1000µL tips.
Centrifuge at 3500RPM for 5 min to pellet contents.
Remove supernatant.
Weigh pellets and subtract the weight of the empty tube to determine the weight of the cecum pellet.
Store pellet aliquots at -80°C.

steps.title: Prepare Bead-Beating Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare tubes with zirconia beads and keep them on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add ~500µL ice-cold 0.5µM zirconia beads to a 2ml RNase-free screw cap tube (1 tube per 100mg cecum contents).
Keep tubes on ice until use.

steps.title: Lysis and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Thaw cecum contents and resuspend in lysis reagents.

substeps.instruction: Place cecum contents aliquots on ice to thaw.

Resuspend aliquot based on 100mg of content (multiply all volumes by 2 for 200mg): 500µL Lysis Buffer (200 mM NaCl, 20mM EDTA), 210µL 20% SDS, and 500µL phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (PCI) (pH 4.5, 125:24:1).
Transfer resuspended cecum contents to the screw-cap tube containing beads.
Split the total volume between 2 bead-beating tubes (each containing ~1210uL).

steps.title: Phenol-Chloroform Extractions
steps.instruction: Perform a series of PCI extractions to purify the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10000xg for 5 minutes to separate phases.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new Eppendorf tube.
Add equal volumes of PCI and vortex for 20s; spin at 10000xg for 5 minutes.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a phase-lock tube (heavy).
Add equal volume of PCI, shake well to mix, and spin at 10000xg for 3 minutes.
Add equal volume PCI to the aqueous layer above the phase-lock layer, mix well by shaking, and spin at 10000xg for 3 minutes.
Repeat the previous step (adding PCI, mixing, and spinning) two more times for a total of 6 Phenol chloroform extractions, moving the aqueous phase to a new phase-lock tube as needed.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA from the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Decant the aqueous phase from the phase-lock tube into a new RNase-free 1.5ml Eppendorf tube.
Add 1 volume of RT isopropanol and place at -20°C for exactly 20 minutes (avoid exceeding 20 minutes to prevent carbohydrate crashing).
Centrifuge at max speed for 25 min at 4°C to form a disk of RNA between two layers.

steps.title: RNA Washing and Drying
steps.instruction: Remove contaminants and dry the RNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove ALL liquid from the tube, both above and below the nucleic acid disk.
Wash 2X with 750µl 75% ethanol by inverting the tube.
Centrifuge at max speed for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove all ethanol (remove supernatant, quick spin, and use aspirator for residual ethanol).
Air dry the pellet for <5 min if significant residual ethanol remains.

steps.title: Initial Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet in nuclease-free water.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 50 µL 45°C nuclease-free water.
Place at 45°C for a few minutes to ensure the pellet is completely resuspended.

steps.title: RNA Column Cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA using a spin-cartridge system.

substeps.instruction: Add 2X RNA Cleanup Buffer (100µl buffer to 50µl sample).
Add 1 volume (150µl) of 100% ethanol to the sample.
Invert/flick to mix and transfer to a spin-cartridge.
Spin at 12000xg for 1 min and discard flow-through.
Add 700µL wash buffer I, centrifuge, and discard flow-through.
Wash 2X with 500µL wash buffer II, centrifuge, and discard flow-through.
Centrifuge spin-cartridge at ~12000xg for 1 min to dry the column and membrane.
Place the dried column in a clean Eppendorf tube.
Add 50µl nuclease-free water to the center of the membrane, incubate at RT for 1 min, and centrifuge to collect flow-through.

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove contaminating DNA from the RNA sample.

substeps.instruction: To the 50µL sample, add 5 µL 10X buffer and 1 µl TURBO DNA and mix gently.
Incubate at 37°C for 20-30 minutes.
Vortex the DNAse Inactivation Reagent to resuspend, then add 6 µL to the sample and mix by flicking.
Incubate at RT for 5 minutes, flicking occasionally.
Centrifuge at 10000xg for 1.5 minutes and carefully transfer 50µl into a new tube.

steps.title: Final Lithium Chloride Precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform a final precipitation to concentrate and purify the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 25µl 7.5M Lithium chloride precipitation solution (final concentration 2.5M) and 1µl glycoblue co-precipitant.
Store at -20°C overnight.
Centrifuge at max speed for 25 min at 4°C to form a large, gelatinous pellet.
Wash 2X with 750µl ice-cold 75% ethanol, vortexing for ~30s between washes.
Centrifuge at max speed for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove all ethanol (remove supernatant, quick spin, and use aspirator for residual ethanol).
Air dry the pellet for ~5 min if significant residual ethanol remains.
Resuspend the pellet in 30 µL 50°C nuclease-free water, ensuring complete resuspension.
